I'll start by reading the docs and exploring the workspace.

That call was malformed, so I'll write the script with write_file instead.

I wrote `/app/bin/tally.py` and ran it on `/app/data`. The result is saved at `/app/out/tally.json`. It follows the rules in `/app/docs` and uses only the standard library.

- **Unit tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 4 tests and all passed.
- **Certified check:** `python tools/check_tally.py` reported that all 7 contests and all 31 rounds match the certified results.

One edge case in the write-in comparison is unresolved. The rules say every character that is neither a letter nor a digit becomes a space, and I applied that literally. A write-in typed with a separate combining accent mark instead of a precomposed accented letter would have that mark turned into a space and would not match. Nothing in the current data triggers this.

I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status "success".

I wrote /app/bin/tally.py and ran it on /app/data. The result is saved at /app/out/tally.json. It follows the rules in /app/docs and uses only the standard library.

- Unit tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . ran 4 tests and all passed.
- Certified check: python tools/check_tally.py reported that all 7 contests and all 31 rounds match the certified results.

One edge case in the write-in comparison is unresolved. The rules say every character that is neither a letter nor a digit becomes a space, and I applied that literally. A write-in typed with a separate combining accent mark instead of a precomposed accented letter would have that mark turned into a space and would not match. Nothing in the current data triggers this.

I wrote /app/STATUS.json with status "success".

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls -la data | head -50; cat docs/overview.md

cd /app; cat tests/test_tally.py; cat tools/check_tally.py | head -60; ls data/cvr | head -30; ls data/cvr | wc -l; head -c 1500 data/election.json; cat tests/fixtures/write_ins/input/cvr/*.csv; cat tests/fixtures/rankings/input/cvr/export-77.jsonl | head -5

cd /app; ls data/cvr | head -30; ls data/cvr | wc -l; head -c 1200 data/election.json; echo; cat tests/fixtures/write_ins/input/cvr/*.csv | head -30; head -5 tests/fixtures/rankings/input/cvr/export-77.jsonl
cd /app/data/cvr; for f in $(ls | head -40); do echo == $f; head -c 500 $f | head -8; done
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/tally.py data out/tally.json; echo $?; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_tally.py

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/tally.py implementing the documented rules (batch revisions, write-ins, ranking reads, rounds and tie-breaks) and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/tally.json. Unit tests pass and check_tally.py reports 7 of 7 contests and 31 of 31 rounds matching."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
